about: Per-home-club watch links for the National League Cup LIVE embed (embeds/nl-cup-live.html). Keyed by the club name exactly as the NLS API returns it, because that is the join key the widget already has in hand. One URL per HOST club: every cup tie is played at a member club's ground, and a club's stream page does not change from round to round, so the same link serves every game that club hosts all season. An empty string means 'no link yet' — that card still renders, it just is not clickable. Add a club here the season it enters the cup; entrants per season live in competitions-meta.json.
